objective_resolver: PDE check the coupled Riccati bootstrap: (a) is ‖R[q]‖≲q² and the 2D-enstrophy sign condition (Cq²−ν)≤0 for q<q* genuine; (b) is q_n≲s_n→0 the cascade's defining selection property (not circular) so threshold-crossing is satisfied; (c) do BOTH cutoff-commutators close at the stated orders (q-eq via tick570 R1, p̄-eq via Ladyzhenskaya enstrophy). success iff bootstrap self-consistently closes with only cited inputs; 0.5 if one extra standard hypothesis (e.g. uniform initial 2D enstrophy) needed; fail iff circular with asymptotic-tangentiality OR a cutoff-commutator escapes the stated order.
question: Does the LOCALIZED Raugel-Sell coupled bootstrap close at R1/(iii) order? q=‖Nu·W‖ obeys d/ds q² ≤ −(νλ₁−O(s_n))q² + (back-reaction from 2D-avg p̄) + CΛ⁻¹M; p̄ is 2D-NSE (Ladyzhenskaya global) forced by Reynolds R[q]≲q²; 2D enstrophy d/ds‖∇p̄‖² ≤ (Cq²−ν)‖Δp̄‖² ≤0 for q<q*=√(ν/C) ⇒ bounded; asymptotic tangentiality s_n→0 ⇒ q_n eventually <q* (pec_c threshold dichotomy) ⇒ contraction persists ⇒ Σ s_n<∞. Closes given only cited inputs (Ladyzhenskaya, tick570 R1, tick573 λ₁=π²) — no new atom — OR is q_n<q* circular w/ the asymptotic-tangentiality hypothesis?
